Maya (Product): quick proposal — leaning on a lightweight rollout pattern i’m calling \"signet\". purpose: fast safety checks + minimal telemetry cost for customer-driven asks. sketch: 1) internal smoke (team only) 2) 1% customer alpha (weighted by traffic) 3) regional ramp (EU/NA then APAC) 4) full cutover. fallback = deterministic route to baseline model variant (model:v1-stable) + traffic shed if latency or error SLOs hit.

Jon (Eng): sounds good. what's the gating signal here? p50/p95 latency, error-rate, and quality regression on our eval set?

Maya (Product): yes — acceptance signals = p95 latency change <= +40ms, 95th token error-rate delta < 0.1%, and quality on a 10k prompt eval <= -0.5 points. also require no new 5xx spike and no memory/caching regressions.

Priya (SRE): add-ons from ops: concurrency guard (per-region per-tenant qps cap), circuit breaker after 3 consecutive 500s for a tenant, and automated rollback if incident count > 5 in 15m. need dashboards and two alerts: 
- signet_p95_delta > 50ms for 10m
- signet_5xx_rate > 0.5% for 5m

Sam (Platform): how do we express the flag + staged weights? propose a small declarative shape we can reuse:
```json
{
  \"flag\": \"signet_routing\",
  \"stages\": [
    {\"name\":\"internal\",\"pct\":0.0,\"targets\":[\"#team\"]},
    {\"name\":\"alpha\",\"pct\":1,\"targets\":[\"cohort:alpha\"]},
    {\"name\":\"regional-ramp\",\"pct\":20,\"region\":[\"eu\",\"na\"]},
    {\"name\":\"global\",\"pct\":100}
  ],
  \"fallback\":\"model:v1-stable\",
  \"kill-switch\":\"global-disable\"
}
```
This can be pushed as a feature-flag bundle.

Jon (Eng): we should also include a shadow mode for the alpha stage — mirror requests to the new variant for quality telemetry without affecting customers. will need KV-cache keying aligned so cache skew doesn't bias latency.

Priya (SRE): agree on shadowing for quality. also require a short bake window per stage: internal 10m, alpha 4h (with continuous signal check), regional 24h, global 72h (for long-tail telemetry). if any stage fails criteria, auto-decrease to previous stage and page.

Maya (Product): customer negotiation note — for customers asking to opt-in early we offer a signed opt-in with SLA-exception + a rollback clause. include Solutions Eng in opt-ins (cc @Sam).

Sam (Platform): ops note: we'll reserve a small pool in Dedicated for alpha cohorts to avoid noisy neighbors hitting host-level latency. estimate: 1 GPU shard per 50k requests/day for alpha window.

Maya (Product): checklist before alpha deploy:
- [ ] runbook + kill-switch documented
- [ ] dashboards + alerts wired to oncall
- [ ] eval harness run (10k prompts) + pass quality gate
- [ ] shadowing enabled
- [ ] opt-in customers notified

Jon (Eng): dev tasks: short PR to runtime to expose flag metadata (stages + fallback), add metric prefix `signet_*`, and a tiny shim for routing fallback precedence. i'll take it, ETA EOD tomorrow.

Priya (SRE): i'll draft the alerting pages and add the small paged-runbook.

ops-bot: runbook created: https://redwood.tools/runbooks/signet-rollout-1748600123 — added owners: Maya, Jon, Priya.

Maya (Product): great. final ask — can we lock the alpha cohort to churn-stable customers (low volatility) and exclude enterprise tenants with custom SLAs until regional passes? :thumbsup:

Sam (Platform): yep. we'll parametrize target cohorts. i'll add the gating flag to the tenant mapping service.

Jon (Eng): sounds good. if no objections i'll cut the alpha on Mon 09:00 PT.

Priya (SRE): no objections from SRE side.

Maya (Product): ok locking schedule. thanks all — will update the rollout doc and ping customer-success for opt-ins. :party-parrot:
